rail.conflictDesc: The hints and the confirmed stops can't all hold at once. Check what you entered — usually "X is the most" was read as "X appears once", or a hint was missed.
rail.hintDisabled: The terminus has no stops after it — no hint to record
rail.nextUncertain: The next stop ({n}) is still undetermined
rail.allKnownDesc: All {n} stop types are filled in — nothing left to infer.
rail.disclaimer: Hints and payout figures come from player-measured guides written during open beta, not from official data; the market refreshes server-wide every Monday, so trust the game itself.
rail.modeToHud: Switch to Cockpit: only what matters while trading (pin the window on top first)
rail.modeToFull: Switch to Full layout: the entire 16-station table, for checking and review
rail.hudNextTagTip: The prediction is for the stop ahead, not the one you are standing at
rail.hudRecordTip: Record this stop's type and hint — it moves on by itself once both are set
rail.hudGoFix: Click to switch to Full layout and fill them in
rail.hudDoneAllDesc: Every stop type is recorded — no need to watch the panel.
rail.hudAlertSameDetail: Stop {next} is {type}, same as stop {prev} — you'll have nothing left to sell
rail.hudActCertain: Next stop {type}: take a global / permanent "sells for more" gold card
rail.hudActUncertain: Fall back on a generic card: trading-house favour I / II
rail.hudActOrigin: Origin: turn cash into cargo first
rail.hudActTail: Final stretch: hold your gamble gold cards
rail.hudWaitNext: Finish this stop, then head to the next
rail.hudFloat: Float mode: hide the title bar and toolbar, keep only the route and entry panel, and pin on top
rail.allRecordsTip: Open all 16 stops and fix any cell in place (works in float mode too)
rail.allRecordsSub: All 16 stops — recalculated as you edit
rail.resetTip: Clear all 16 stops and return to the origin (asks once first)
rail.resetConfirmBody: Every type and hint will be cleared and the cursor goes back to the origin. This cannot be undone.
rail.optHintSameTip: All types that appear have equal counts (3 stops: one of each; 2 stops: two different types)

conflict.title: Fix the stop record before judging cards
conflict.detail: No arrangement is possible with the current entries. One of these is most likely mis-recorded: {what} — removing any one of them makes the rest consistent.

allKnown.title: Every stop is confirmed
allKnown.detail: Nothing left to infer — trade out the rest of the route.

origin.title: Origin: record the hint only — no type to pick
origin.act: The origin usually has the cheapest prices — turn cash into cargo first
origin.detail: The origin is not one of the three shop types, so there is no type to record. Its "next 3 stops" hint covers stops 2–4 — writing it down already narrows stop 2.

certain.title: The next stop is confirmed to be {type}
certain.act: Take a global or permanent "sells for more" gold card first — the earlier the better
certain.detail: Then a "lower purchase price" card, then a {type}-specific contract, haggling or upgrade card

dontBoostSame.title: Skip "next stop sells for more"
dontBoostSame.detail: The next stop is {type}, same as the one before it: you already sold out, so there is nothing to sell and the card is worth zero. Save it for the next {type} stop.

uncertain.title: Next stop undetermined — fall back on a generic card
uncertain.act: Trading-house favour I (next stop buys at −30%) or II (next stop sells at +30%)
uncertain.detail: Otherwise narrow it down by rule-out. Reroll if you like — but never reroll away a gold card.

earlyGame.title: Don't agonise over the first 4 stops
earlyGame.detail: Opening hints barely constrain the next stop. Bank cash as cargo instead of guessing.

tail.title: Final stretch — hold your gamble gold cards
tail.detail: The gamble card (next stop sells at +125%) is your main scorer. The winery has no gold gamble card, so take a gold seal or transfer card there instead.

backToBack.title: Two stops of the same type in a row — hold one beat
backToBack.detail: Try to roll "advance by retreating": do nothing this stop, and the next stop buys at −80% and sells at +80%.

rhythm.title: General rhythm
rhythm.detail: Buy cargo and collect global buffs early, hoard and upgrade to gold mid-route, then dump everything at a high price late.

rail.originNoTypeTip: The origin has no shop type — record only its hint
rail.hintCoversLong: This hint covers stops {from}–{to} (not this one)
rail.hintCoversOneLong: This hint covers stop {to} (not this one)
rail.colHintTip: Record the "next 3 stops" hint the game shows here. Each hint covers up to the 3 stops after this one (narrower near the end of the route), not this one.
rail.exportDesc: Export this route's 16 stops as JSON, then use Import on your other device (phone or PC) to carry on.
rail.importDesc: Paste JSON exported from another device, or pick a file. Importing replaces the current records.
rail.importBadJson: That text is not valid JSON
rail.importBadShape: No recognisable stop records in that JSON
rail.importBadKind: That file was exported by a different tool, not the rail tycoon
rail.mobileNoOverlay: The "display over other apps" permission is not granted yet
rail.mobileBatteryHint: Aggressive battery savers can kill the panel: whitelist this app for autostart / background running and set its battery policy to unrestricted.
rail.mobileNotifHint: If notification permission is denied the foreground-service notification won't appear in the shade (the service still runs), but it stays visible — and stoppable — under the system's running-apps view.

registry.toolRailDesc: Lord of the Mysteries homestead trade run: enumerate every valid stop layout from the "next 3 stops" hints to lock the next stop and pick cards
